_comment: ARC-AGI-1 main run (docs/decisions.md): TRM split and augmentation (data/arc1_trm.npz), TRM optimisation (AdamATan2 0.9/0.95, lr 1e-4 after 2000 warmup steps, wd 0.1, EMA 0.999, global batch 768), loops 16 without ACT (all lanes replaced together), 8 blocks per segment with the last 4 backpropagated (10-25: back from 2 to 4 after the <=10 ablation), TRM lm loss, no gradient clipping, Gamma term on (frames 8), trace update as the fused Triton kernel (fused_bands, FP32 arithmetic) with the traces stored in BF16 between blocks (trace_dtype, 10-25). 50k epochs = int(50000 x 960 x 4.1458 / 768) = 259,113 steps; the user may stop earlier: when the user says stop, scripts/run.sh stop, then scripts/run.sh eval.
